title: Fix Open WebUI iOS backgrounding frozen-chat bug
description:
Source issue: https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/26844

Bug summary:
On iOS Safari, if Open WebUI is backgrounded immediately after sending a chat and then reopened after the response finishes, the conversation can remain stuck in a loading state until the page is refreshed. The completed response exists server-side, so this appears to be a client-side resume / reconnection state bug.

Scope:
- Reproduce the mobile backgrounding issue described in the GitHub issue.
- Identify the client-side root cause around resume, websocket loss, or state refresh after returning from background.
- Implement a fix so completed chat state is restored when returning to the app.
- Verify behavior on the affected mobile flow.

Acceptance criteria:
- Returning to Open WebUI after backgrounding no longer leaves the chat stuck loading.
- The completed response becomes visible without requiring a manual refresh.
- Include a short implementation note with root cause, files changed, and verification steps.
- Prefer a PR-ready patch or clean change set.

Tech context:
Likely fits TypeScript / React / mobile web state-management debugging work.
